title: Rainbow Field

sections.heading: Description
lines: Rainbow Field is one of the Field Effects present in Rejuvenation. It is classified as a Magical field.

sections.heading: Transitions From Other Fields
lines: This field can be eihter generated (suppresses the effects of the original field while Rainbow Field is active) or overlayed (the original field is acitve, the Rainbow field has less effects). Effects present in the overlay will be highlighted with an underline.

Once Rainbow Field expires, the original field returns. Rainbow Field cannot be generated or overlayed while Frozen Dimensional Field or Underwater Field is active. Rainbow Field overlay disappears if a different overlay is set while it's still active.

This field is generated by the moves Grass Pledge and Fire Pledge when used one after the other in a battle (any number of turns apart, as long as the active field is not changed in those turns). The field lasts for 4 turns normally and 7 turns if the user of the second move holds an Amplifield Rock. If either move is used again while the field is active, the duration of the field will be refreshed.
“The pledges combined to form a rainbow!”
“The pledges combined to refresh the rainbow!”

This field is overlayed when either Sunlight (Harsh or Extremely Harsh) is generated to replace Rain (regular or Heavy), or vice versa. The field will last for as long as the new weather lasts. If the weather switches again from Rain to Sun or Sun to Rain, the field will last for as long as that new weather lasts.
“The weather created a rainbow!”
“The weather refreshed the rainbow!”
If there is no active field, the field will be generated instead of being overlayed.

sections.heading: General Effects
lines: Special Normal-type moves → 1.5x boost (1.3x when overlayed) and random sub-typing.
“The rainbow energized the attack!”
The secondary effect chance of each move is doubled.
This stacks with Serene Grace except for moves that can cause the target the flinch.
Sleeping Pokémon recover 1/16 of their max HP each turn.
“[Pokémon] recovered health in its peaceful sleep!”

sections.heading: Abilities affected
lines: Activated Abilities:
Marvel Scale
Buffed Abilities:
Cloud Nine will randomly boost one stat at the end of each turn.
This does not include Critical Hit rate.
Pastel Veil halves damage from Poison type attacks for the user and its allies.
Prism Armor reduces all damage to the user by 25%.
Specifically, it raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 33%.
Soul Heart boosts Special Defense by 1 stage when activated.
Wonder Skin will cause the bearer to evade all non-beneficial status moves.
Nerfed Abilities:
Bad Dreams has no effect.

sections.heading: Moves Affected
lines: Damage Modifiers: Moves which receive an attack buff:

Aurora Beam, Dazzling Gleam, Dragon Pulse, Fire Pledge, Fleur Cannon, Grass Pledge, Heart Stamp, Hidden Power, Judgment, Lumina Crash, Mirror Beam, Mist Ball, Moonblast, Mystical Fire, Oceanic Operetta, Prismatic Laser, Relic Song, Sacred Fire, Secret Power, Silver Wind, Solarbeam, Solar Blade, Sparkling Aria, Tri Attack, Twinkle Tackle, Water Pledge, Weather Ball, Zen Headbutt → 1.5x boost.
“The attack was rainbow-charged!”
Sonic Boom → Deals 140 HP damage.
“It's a Sonic Rainboom!”
Moves which receive an attack nerf:
Dark Pulse, Never-Ending Nightmare, Night Daze, Shadow Ball → 0.5x decrease.
“The rainbow softened the attack...”
Other moves: Buffed Moves:
Solar Beam and Solar Blade don't require a charging turn.
Aurora Veil can be activated regardless of weather.
Cosmic Power boosts the user's Defense and Special Defense by 2 stages.
Life Dew restores 50% of the user's max HP.
It still restores 25% of the partner's max HP
Meditate boosts the user's Attack by 3 stages.
Weather Ball always deals double damage regardless of weather.
Wish restores 75% of the user's max HP instead of 50%.
Nerfed Moves:
Nightmare fails on use.
Field-dependent moves & Abilities:
Mimicry changes the user's type to Dragon.
Camouflage changes the user's type to Dragon.
Nature Power becomes Aurora Beam.
Secret Power may inflict any non-volatile status randomly.
Shelter halves damage from Dragon-type moves.
Terrain Pulse becomes Dragon-type.

sections.heading: Transitions to Other Fields
lines: Any move in this section inherently gains a 1.3x damage boost on top of any other previously listed modifiers.
The move Sandsear Strom or the Z-Move Light That Burns the Sky will terminate this field.
“The sandstorm blocked out the rainbow!”
“The rainbow was consumed!”
This field will be terminated if the Sandstorm or Snow weathers are active at the end of the turn.
“The weather blocked out the rainbow!”

sections.heading: Items
lines: Magical Seed boosts the user's Special Attack by 1 stage and applies Wish to them.

sections.heading: Notes
lines: Previous to V14, Nightmare displayed a message when used.
“The rainbow ensures good dreams.”
